1.d4 d5 2.c4 dxc4 3.Nf3 Nf6 4.Nc3 c5 5.d.strategy: Gains space and closes the centre. The pawn is defended twice by queen and knight and attacked twice by the f6-knight and the queen, so it holds. White stays a pawn down and bets on space and the lead in development.
Attacks the d5-pawn a third time, with the pawn, the knight and the queen against two defenders, so White must add a defender or lose it. Black keeps the extra pawn and forces White to commit.
